summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Telegram Autopilot feature (Phase 15). All backend APIs, frontend UI, and integration tests passed. Telegram is correctly MOCKED (no real messages sent). Security verified: bot token never exposed in any response.

BACKEND API auth: All endpoints require admin JWT (401/403 without token)

BACKEND API publish-now?dry_run=true: Returns DRY_RUN status with caption containing onlyfans.com and <b> HTML, copy_source=LLM/TEMPLATE, media list with photo/video, queue does NOT advance

BACKEND API settings validation: Invalid schedule_times (25:00) returns 422, invalid timezone (Mars/X) returns 422, invalid posts_per_day (9 with only 4 times) returns 422

BACKEND API logs: Returns items array with log entries containing status, timestamp, model info
BACKEND security: NO response from any endpoint contains token fragment '<REDACTED>' or '<REDACTED>:'
